potions.name: Mana Potion
potions.description: Restores magical energy for casting spells.

potions.name: Health Potion
potions.description: Heals the drinker and restores vitality.

potions.name: Love Draught
potions.description: Stirs warm feelings and deep affection.

potions.name: Antidote Elixir
potions.description: Cures poisons and grants temporary resistance.

potions.name: Flame Elixir
potions.description: Grants temporary fire powers to ignite objects or attack.

potions.name: Mist Drop
potions.description: Creates a cloud of mist to obscure the player from enemies.

potions.name: Shadow Syrup
potions.description: Turns the player into a shadow, becoming invisible to enemies.

potions.name: Lightning Tincture
potions.description: Boosts movement speed and reflexes temporarily.

potions.name: Wisdom Serum
potions.description: Enhances magical insight and puzzle-solving abilities.

potions.name: Frost Essence
potions.description: Slows down nearby enemies with a chilling effect.
